theme: An open day, with a few bookings that can't wait much longer.
greeting: A quiet, meeting-free day, Dan — nothing on the calendar at all. The only pressure is self-imposed: a couple of travel bookings have reached their deadlines, and tomorrow opens with a recruiter call.

needsAttention.title: Recruiter call with Amin at 9:30
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow starts at 9:30 with Amin Noorani on Teams about opportunities. Worth settling tonight which board and executive targets you want to put in front of him.

needsAttention.title: Decide and book the December break
needsAttention.detail: The book-by date for the Dec 13–Jan 2 trip is tomorrow. Holiday inventory for six is the thinnest of the year, and the plan was to default domestic since passports won't be in hand by booking day.

needsAttention.title: Hold the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: The p1 rental — a full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week — is well past its book-this-week date. A refundable hold now removes the risk before that inventory sells out.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive-south window
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5–18 window to drive the Pathfinder from Portland to St Pete closes Saturday. Book the single hotel night once the dates are set.
